constraints: MCP previews require exports, fresh native capture requires checks, and applying requires edits plus the reviewed artifact digest. The CLI can use downloaded selection JSON.

capabilities.reason: Both preview and apply paired footprint/model imports using the same provenance and source guards.
constraints: MCP previews require exports, applications require edits, and external official CAD downloads additionally require allow-downloads. Repository, installed and verified cached assets remain usable without network.

capabilities.reason: Both prepare the exact source-bound supplier payload and require an explicit reviewed digest before one external submission attempt.
constraints: Preparation is local under exports. Submission requires a separate supplier-submissions host flag; CLI also needs its explicit submit flag. Neither surface places an order or retries uncertain delivery.

capabilities.reason: Both export charts and full precision CSV from retained, hashed individual or suite electrical analysis receipts.
constraints: MCP requires exports and checkout build receipts; the CLI accepts an explicit fresh output path. Matplotlib is an optional pinned charts dependency.

capabilities.reason: Both import one bounded project-owned CSV through the same time and channel mapping service and retain source bytes, hashes, full-precision data, and offline plots.
constraints: MCP requires exports and a fresh view_id; the CLI chooses a fresh ignored build directory. The user declares time interpretation and each channel unit. No acceptance limit or physical origin is inferred.

capabilities.reason: Both overlay two explicit hash-verified measured receipts with selected channel and time alignment, retaining full source CSVs and offline interaction.
constraints: MCP requires exports and a fresh view_id. Selected channel units must match exactly; each saved artifact and report is verified before plotting.
Historical project sources are labeled. Traces are not interpolated and no acceptance limit or condition equivalence is inferred.

capabilities.reason: Both index the same explicitly selected saved receipts through one typed source and artifact freshness service.
constraints: MCP requires exports and chooses a fresh output by view_id; neither surface discovers the latest receipt or executes engineering checks.
Parts output files and verification summaries without retained source or artifact hashes remain marked unknown where binding cannot be established.

capabilities.reason: Both compare two explicitly selected saved overview receipts and optional release manifests through the same typed history service.
constraints: MCP requires exports and a fresh view_id; neither surface chooses a revision or reruns a check.
Saved overview freshness is capture-time state; every snapshot is separately labeled against the live source at comparison time.
Release manifest status and artifact presence are separate from packaging and approval.

capabilities.reason: Both compare one explicitly authored ground domain with saved, hash-bound netlist observations and retain missing or unreviewed pins.
constraints: MCP requires exports and a fresh view_id. This view reports schematic netlist membership only; it does not infer common grounds or physical copper continuity.

capabilities.reason: Both render one authored source/load rail with retained, hash-bound netlist membership and optional authored budget values.
constraints: MCP requires exports and a fresh view_id. Missing native evidence stays unreviewed; the view does not infer topology from net names or prove PCB copper or component behavior.

capabilities.reason: Both generate an offline source-bound schematic and PCB review from the same retained native findings and optional design-lint snapshot.
constraints: Supported PCB DRC, source-bound schematic geometry, and exact KiCad 10.0.6 UUID-sheet ERC items receive markers only on verified drawings; parity and unsupported locations remain listed.
MCP requires exports and chooses a fresh output by view_id; both surfaces read existing evidence and do not execute native tools.

capabilities.reason: Both check an exact LCSC identity, retain a frozen source bundle and preview a project-local CAD import.
constraints: MCP requires exports; live community-provider downloads also require allow-downloads. Verified cached assets remain usable without network.

capabilities.reason: Both preview and apply source-bound project-local symbol, footprint and paired WRL imports from exact CAD bundles.
constraints: MCP requires exports for preview, edits and an exact reviewed plan digest for apply; paths are confined to this checkout.

capabilities.reason: Both run pinned KiCad WRL and STEP comparison views for an exact sourced part and preserve REVIEW instead of physical-fit approval.
constraints: MCP requires checks and exports; a fresh provider lookup also requires allow-downloads unless the exact source is cached. Saved source reports can be reused.

capabilities.reason: The local browser assistant presents the same reviewed parts services interactively.
capabilities.exception: CLI --assist starts a long-running browser session. MCP exposes its bounded underlying operations and never starts a second server that could bypass MCP startup capabilities.

capabilities.reason: Hosted runner orchestration belongs to Actions and the operator CLI; the native lane runs source-bound PCB return-path controls, alternate-layer connected/open cases with retained via geometry, component membership, and per-track endpoint pad/via contacts; connected/split-plane fixtures with SMD and plated through-hole pads; an extra filled island without a pad anchor; fitted/DNP net-tie controls; valid/bridged separate-domain isolation cases; a mapped 4/15 signal-centerline coverage fault with a 0.25 valid control and repeated source-bound geometry capture; and probe-envelope geometry fault/control fixtures through the exact project image. Package acceptance runs these fixtures on the reviewed KiCad 10.0.0 and 10.0.5 images. Project selection and portable checks remain available through plan_impact and check_scope in MCP. Preview logging and Actions summaries wrap the same renderer used by MCP export_3d.
capabilities.exception: MCP does not schedule GitHub jobs, pull Docker images or run the release rehearsal. Its shared planning and check services expose the project, tag and shard decisions.

capabilities.reason: Both review the same saved measured-series receipt against project-owned capture context and an optional authored voltage envelope through one typed service.
constraints: MCP requires exports and a fresh view_id; CLI chooses a fresh ignored build directory. Exact units and conditions must match. Missing limits, stale evidence, and unsupported kinds are visible, and no physical origin or approval is inferred.

capabilities.reason: Both package the same explicit overview snapshots, selected findings, and project-owned reviewer notes through one typed service.
constraints: MCP requires exports and a fresh view_id; CLI chooses a fresh ignored build directory. Notes stay project-owned and are read-only here; no approval is inferred.
Evidence is retained only when selected receipt hashes still match; absent drawings and outdated fingerprints remain visible.

capabilities.reason: Both compare the same two explicit dated sourcing snapshots against one saved source-bound BOM using the same typed pricing service.
constraints: MCP requires exports and a fresh view_id; CLI chooses a fresh ignored build directory. As-of date and maximum age are explicit. Packaging is never assumed and currencies are never converted.
Availability, lead times and offer prices are recorded observations; neither surface places an order or authorizes purchasing.
